long_description:
Think Gaming uses data science to connect the best mobile freemium games with publishers and investors that can help them grow.

We've analyzed 5000+ games using a proprietary data set to find the keys to predictable success. Our free Scouting Reports compare games to top grossing peers and assess their likelihood of becoming the next billion dollar mobile game.
